title: Certified Cognitive Continuity Fabric — whole-mesh Fusion F5
core: One Clay semantic organism can preserve continuous between-call associative state while keeping canonical truth, query/collection identity, GWT selection, reader projection and effect authority causally distinct. Deterministic certification validates integrity, not cognitive relevance.
new_deltas: Collection algebra is part of query/selection causal identity.
Integrity checks can contain stale/revoked activation but cannot generally detect authentic role-shuffled misleading relevance.
Persistent memory mutation should derive from canonical outcome/re-entry events.
Dual-path memory (background activation + explicit retrieval/validation) is the current best policy hypothesis.
Target-4B continuity factorial outranks further architecture convergence in expected information gain.
falsifier: Target-4B matched-information tests fail to show a truthful continuity benefit or show one fixed simpler memory/runtime architecture Pareto-dominates C3F.
